greet.text: Sailor Bess — retired from the sea, promoted to the feast committee. At Midwinter this inn feeds every soul in port, and the kitchen inhales smoked herring faster than the smoker can hang them.

effects.missingText: That's not a pair of herring. The Fish Market strings them fresh — hurry, the feast won't wait.
effects.successText: Straight to the feast table! 60 crystals, and a seat by the fire if you stay.

greet.text: Nets, sails, hammocks — if it's stitched, I've stitched it. Bring me three good feathers and I'll sew you a pillow soft enough to make a harbourmaster weep.

effects.missingText: That's not three feathers. Well-fed chickens shed them all over the realm.
effects.successText: Needle, thread, and done — one feather pillow, double-stitched. Someone out there needs this more than you know.

greet.text: Every instrument in this lighthouse is older than my grandmother's grudges. What I'd give for a proper gilded compass — the Ravenwatch guild certifies them, but they won't sell to outsiders.

effects.missingText: You've no such instrument. The Merchant's Guild Hall in Ravenwatch keeps them under glass — for those the town holds in high standing.
effects.successText: She checks it against true north and actually smiles. 'Perfect swing. The strait just got safer.' 160 crystals, keeper's honour.

greet.text: The Admiralty inspection is next month and my ceremonial hat was eaten — EATEN — by a gull. The capital tailor stocks proper ones. I'd pay handsomely to be spared the errand.

effects.missingText: You have no hat worth presenting. Pell's Tailoring in the capital keeps them in stock.
effects.successText: He sets it on his head and checks his reflection in the harbour bell. 'Impeccable.' 75 crystals, dispensed with full ceremony.

greet.text: Fresh off the boat or fresh off your line, makes no difference to me — I pay fair coin for fish, same rates as anywhere on the coast.

sell.text: Lay it on the slab, then. What have you got?

effects.successText: Bait-box size, but coin's coin. 3 crystals.

effects.missingText: No small fish in that pack.
You've no medium fish on you.
You've no large fish on you.
A trophy fish? Show me first.
effects.successText: The whole dock will hear about this one. 45 crystals!

effects.missingText: Legendary, is it? I'll believe fins when I see them.
effects.successText: By the deep… I'll retire on the story alone. 90 crystals.

quests.title: The Dockside Cat
quests.offerDialogue: That grey tom haunts my stall day and night, the beggar. Fetch three fish heads from along the wharf and feed him, will you? Maybe then he'll let me work in peace.
quests.activeDialogue: Three fish heads off the wharf, then take them to that grey cat by the docks.
quests.completeDialogue: Well I never — he's actually content. Take this for your trouble, love.

quests.title: The Missing Manifest
quests.offerDialogue: Three crates walked off my quay this week. Crates don't walk — so either I have thieves or very ambitious crabs. They can't have gone far. Find them and the port owes you a favour.
quests.activeDialogue: Three crates, stamped with the port seal. Check along the waterfront and behind the inn.
quests.completeDialogue: All three, seals intact. So — lazy thieves, not clever ones. Good. The manifest balances and so do my nerves. Here's your finder's fee.

quests.title: Barrel of Trouble
quests.offerDialogue: There's a barrel of navy rum washed up under the south pier. If the watch finds it first, someone hangs for smuggling, and I've got the only ladder down there. Fish it out and hand it to Vane official-like, would you? Keeps everyone's neck the right length.

activeDialogue.barrel: The barrel's under the south pier, past the inn. Can't miss it — it's the only barrel acting suspicious.
activeDialogue.deliver: Got it? Straight to Harbourmaster Vane. Walk natural.

quests.completeDialogue: Salvaged cargo, declared properly? You may be the first honest soul on this dock in a decade. The navy pays recovery rates — your share, as the law requires.

quests.title: Begging Privileges
quests.offerDialogue: That dock cat of yours has taken a liking to my smoke racks — keeps creeping in for scraps. Save us both the bother: gather what's fallen round back of the smokehouse and feed him proper.
quests.activeDialogue: Three scraps from round the smokehouse, then back to Barnacle before he wrecks my racks again.
quests.completeDialogue: Good riddance — he's gone back to bothering the fishwife instead. Here, for your trouble.

quests.title: Paper Trail
quests.offerDialogue: Vane's crates turned up, but the paperwork's a mess — pages scattered clean across the customs floor. Bring them back so I can match the seals to the manifest.
quests.activeDialogue: Two loose pages, somewhere between here and the harbourmaster's.
quests.completeDialogue: Numbers match, seals match. Whoever scattered these wanted us looking the wrong way. Worth knowing. Here's for your eyes.

quests.title: The Ledger
quests.offerDialogue: That rum barrel had a ledger tucked inside the lid — names, dates, drop points. Someone in Warehouse Row's been running more than fish. Find their book and take it straight to them. Let's see their face when they realize we know.

activeDialogue.ledger: The ledger's somewhere in Warehouse Row.
activeDialogue.deliver: Found it? Take it to whoever it belongs to.

quests.completeDialogue: ...So Vane knows. Smart of you, keeping this quiet — for both our sakes. Take this and forget you ever saw my ledger.

quests.title: Net Gains
quests.offerDialogue: Storm dragged half my nets clean off the racks. If they're not chewed through by crabs they're still mendable — bring back what you find.
quests.activeDialogue: Torn nets, scattered wherever the storm dropped them — try the wharf and the jetty.
quests.completeDialogue: Still good thread in these. Knew you had a sailor's eye. Here — take your cut.

quests.title: Keel Repair
quests.offerDialogue: Got a hull on the blocks that won't float 'til I patch her keel. Timber's stacked all over this row — half of it not where I left it. Round it up for me?
quests.activeDialogue: Timber bundles, somewhere along Warehouse Row. Mind the splinters.
quests.completeDialogue: That'll do her. Few days and she's seaworthy again. Couldn't have hauled it faster myself.

quests.title: Maiden Voyage
quests.offerDialogue: She's patched and ready, but Vane won't clear a launch without the proper supplies aboard. Run these down to the harbourmaster and she'll have her maiden voyage by dusk.

activeDialogue.supplies: Crate and barrel, bound for Harbourmaster Vane. Don't let them roll off the dock.

quests.completeDialogue: Supplies logged, hull cleared. The shipwright's boat sails today, and that's down to you. Well earned.

quests.title: Oil for the Lamp
quests.offerDialogue: Lamp's burning low and my knees aren't what they were for climbing with full flasks. Bring me oil from round the point and I'll keep the light lit another season.
quests.activeDialogue: Oil flasks, scattered round the headland and the jetty.
quests.completeDialogue: That'll see us through the dark months. Ships sleep easier for it, even if they never know your name.

quests.title: The Long Watch
quests.offerDialogue: Oil's not worth much if no one's watching it burn. There's a spare signal flare down below and one I left up in the lamp room years back — fetch both and I'll show you how we call for help out here.
quests.activeDialogue: One flare near the base of the lighthouse, the other still up in the lamp room — don't trip on the stairs.
quests.completeDialogue: There. Three short, one long — that's how we call for help out here. Now you know it too.

quests.title: Warehouse Count
quests.offerDialogue: Inventory day, and half these crates have wandered off down the row again. Vane doesn't pay me enough to chase them myself — fancy the job?
quests.activeDialogue: Four stray crates, scattered up and down Warehouse Row.
quests.completeDialogue: Counted, stacked, and not a single one missing. You're better at this than I am, and I do it for a living.

quests.title: Lost at Sea
quests.offerDialogue: Lost three trinkets off this quay over the years — a ring, a button, a coin I shouldn't have bet. Don't expect you'll find them, but if the tide's kind...
quests.activeDialogue: Trinkets, washed up somewhere along the original quay.
quests.completeDialogue: Well, I'm damned. Forty years I've walked past these and never looked down. Sit a while — let me tell you where they came from.

quests.title: Ship's Stores
quests.offerDialogue: Half my rope's walked off the shelves before I could sell it — sailors helping themselves, I'd wager. Bring back what's loose and I'll square you for the bother.
quests.activeDialogue: Coiled rope, dropped somewhere round the shop frontage.
quests.completeDialogue: Back where it belongs. You'd make a fair shopkeep, if the sea ever lets you go.

quests.title: The Lost Manifest
quests.offerDialogue: Found a duplicate manifest in my files — cargo bound for Ravenwatch's market that never got logged proper on their end. Run it up to their market warden, would you? Save us both an audit.

activeDialogue.manifest: The manifest's yours to carry. Ravenwatch's market warden will want it.
activeDialogue.deliver: Find the market warden in Ravenwatch and hand it over.

quests.completeDialogue: A manifest from Saltmere, and an honest one at that. Tell Vane the books are square. And — thank you, truly, for carrying it all this way.
